retrieval._note: structural chunking + hybrid search + reranker on rag/eval/retrieval_questions.jsonl; measured MRR 0.76 / recall@5 0.93 / recall@10 0.93 locally and 0.70 / 0.87 / 0.87 in CI (the difference is one question, q12, which sits in the last slot of the reranker pool); the minimums leave room for one question

answers._note: deterministic scorers on rag/eval/testset.jsonl (28 questions); measured for prompt v3: pass_all 0.93, pass_trap 1.0, refused_when_unanswerable 1.0

answers_live._note: for the manual run with the real model (the answers change from run to run: 26/28, 26/28, 24/28 for the same prompt and settings), so the minimums leave room for about two questions; the strict 'answers' minimums stay for the saved answers

judge._note: LLM judge (gpt-4o, prompt judge_v2); measured for prompt v3: correct 0.86-0.89, faithful 0.95-1.0
